data.name: Arena Blast
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO THE ARENA


Arena Blast is a colorful third-person arena shooter built around fast matches, different game modes, and a carefully measured amount of uncontrolled chaos.

Pick your weapon, customize your look, gather your friends, and jump into the same arena with players across Steam, Android, and iOS.

You can make a team strategy before the match. You might even follow it for the first eight seconds.

🔫 PICK YOUR WEAPON — LET YOUR OPPONENT WORRY ABOUT THE REST


Every weapon offers a different way to fight.

Push your opponents at close range, control the arena from a distance, or bring enough firepower to ruin everybody’s carefully prepared plans.

Unlock new weapons, equip your favorites, and build a playstyle that works for you. Using the right weapon at the right time gives you a serious advantage. Using the wrong weapon with unreasonable confidence can still look impressive.

BRING YOUR OWN STYLE


Defeating your opponents may be important, but you do not have to do it while dressed like everyone else.

Customize your character with different outfits and cosmetic items. Unlock new appearances, create your favorite combination, and eliminate your opponents while looking unnecessarily stylish.

You may lose the match. Looking bad is still optional.

🎮 DIFFERENT MODES, SAME CHAOS


Arena Blast features a variety of game modes with different rules and objectives:

  • Team Deathmatch: Work with your team and score more eliminations than your opponents. Teamwork is recommended. Actual teamwork is not guaranteed.
  • Free for All: No teams, no friendships, and definitely no excuses. The player with the highest score wins.
  • Capture the Flag: Steal the enemy flag, carry it back to your base, and try not to drop it halfway there. It sounds simple. It usually is not.
  • Hot Zone: Capture the objective and hold your ground. Running away is, surprisingly, not a particularly effective strategy here.
  • Zombie Invasion: Fight against waves of zombies. There are many of them, they never get tired, and none of them understand personal space.

Every mode requires a different approach. Coordinate with your team, use the arena to your advantage, or trust your reflexes and pretend the outcome was part of the plan.

THE CROWD IS WATCHING — TRY NOT TO EMBARRASS YOURSELF


Forget ordinary battlefields. In Arena Blast, you fight inside colorful stadiums under bright lights and in front of energetic spectators.

Use jump platforms, capture strong positions, and attack your opponents from unexpected angles while the crowd reacts to the action.

Make a great play and they will cheer. Make a terrible one and at least somebody was entertained.

GATHER YOUR FRIENDS


Add your friends, create a party, and enter matches together. Choose your weapons, prepare an extremely serious strategy, and then watch everyone run in a different direction during the first fight.

No friends online? Available player slots can be filled by bots. Bots will not judge you. At least not yet.

🌍 THE SAME ARENA ON PC AND MOBILE


Arena Blast supports cross-platform multiplayer across Steam, Android, and iOS.

No matter which device your friends use, you can meet in the same matches, create a party, and compete against players from around the world.

Phone or PC? The arena does not really care. An opponent is still an opponent.

🏆 COLLECT TROPHIES AND CLIMB


Win matches, collect trophies, and climb the leaderboards.

Compete across daily, weekly, and all-time rankings. Build winning streaks, improve your performance, and fight your way toward the top.

There is plenty of room near the bottom too. We just do not advertise it.

CLAIM YOUR REWARDS


Complete daily and weekly missions, earn rewards, and unlock new content.

The Battle Pass, Trophy Road, daily rewards, chests, and limited-time events provide new goals every time you return to the arena.

Because eliminating opponents is not enough. Sometimes you also need to open a chest and stare at what comes out.

FACE YOUR MATCH STATS


Review your eliminations, deaths, headshots, accuracy, and other performance statistics after each match.

If you get eliminated, the Kill Cam can show you exactly what happened. Learn from it, return stronger, and repeat the same mistake with much better technique.

Add Arena Blast to your wishlist, gather your friends, and prepare to enter the arena on Steam.

data.short_description: Arena Blast is a fast-paced third-person shooter that throws Steam, Android, and iOS players into the same arena. Pick your weapon, customize your look, gather your friends, and cause trouble across different game modes. Making a plan is optional. Sticking to it is rare.
